Per-tenant runtimes and Node gateways

A source-linked technical walkthrough. Trace the flow, explain the boundary, then test the failure path.

After this session, you can:
  • Separate business and control runtimes
  • Trace gateway failure handling
  • Understand provider and service adapters

Technical flow

1. Isolation is physical

Each tenant has its own business runtime and a separately administered ctrl-* runtime for staffing and identity authority. They cannot share URL, bundle, identity or operator boundary.

2. Two explicit gateways

The business and control Node gateways validate response contracts and map timeout, unavailable service or malformed output to restrictive results. Workflow code consumes only the typed gateway result.

3. Runtime forms

The workspace supports service, native and WebAssembly adapter boundaries without weakening the core contract. Deployment chooses an approved provider while conformance verifies identical policy semantics.
